title: Singapore MRT Station 2017 - 'Holy Cow!' sign photo
summary: A photo labelled 'Singapore MRT Station, Singapore, 2017' showing a smiling grey-haired man in a maroon T-shirt standing in a subway station and gesturing at a bright green pillar with a sign that reads 'HOLY COW! ...JEK IS HERE.'

numbers.note: year the photo was taken, as captioned

pictures.description: Photograph inside a Singapore MRT (metro) station: a smiling grey-haired, bearded man in a maroon Hard Rock T-shirt and light grey shorts stands beside a large lime-green pillar and points at its advertisement, which reads 'HOLY COW! ...JEK IS HERE.' with part of the word hidden by his hand. Behind him are a stainless-steel escalator, a red fire cabinet and a yellow caution sign, and commuters walk along the platform on the right.
pictures.text_in_picture: HOLY COW! JEK IS HERE. (first letters hidden by the man's hand); CAUTION; Hard Rock HYDERABAD (T-shirt)

uncertain: The first letters of the sign's second line are hidden by the man's hand; only 'JEK IS HERE.' is readable (probably 'GOJEK').
